text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Good work.
Right now, I am offering detailed explanations
of "The Twinkle Legends" to anyone interested—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
<username>, 
do you need an explanation?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Now then, what would you like me to explain?

When it comes to what you'd like to know
about "The Twinkle Legends" training—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: About "Dream Fest," right?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The Dream Fest is a brand-new series of races
held at the proposal of our legendary Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Dream Fest takes place three times in total, at the end of each year.
Running in the final Dream Fest will mark the conclusion of training.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: An all-star race to bring excitement to the Twinkle Series... It will surely foster tremendous growth for the Umamusume as well.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Train alongside the Legend Umamusume to grow stronger, and aim for victory across all the Dream Fests!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Furthermore, while participating in the Twinkle Series, everyone will also be running in the Dream Fest.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Please note that depending on training conditions,
your training may conclude before you have participated
in all Dream Fests!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That concludes the explanation regarding "Dream Fest."
Is there anything else you'd like to ask?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Regarding "Training with Legends", yes?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
In this scenario,
legendary Umamusume will oversee
your training for 3 years!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: You'll receive reassuring support from those who once achieved great feats in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: "By executing each command, you can earn Guidance Gauge points from them!"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Which command grants which Guidance Gauge
is determined by a draw each turn.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Additionally, Friendship Training will increase the amount of gauge earned.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The Guidance Gauge you've gathered leads to acquiring insights.
Be sure to collect it proactively!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That concludes the explanation
for "Training with Legends".
Is there anything else you would like to know?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: You're asking about the "principles," right?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: The Insights are principles acquired through the guidance of Legend Umamusume... You could call them the secrets of strength.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: The opportunity to acquire this insight will come once every 6 turns.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Depending on the amount in your Instruction Gauge,
several principles will be presented, and you can
select one of them to learn.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
However, Insights have various effects, and some
won't activate unless certain conditions are met!
These will unlock as you progress in mastering them.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: When the Guidance Gauge reaches maximum, powerful "Secrets" are more likely to appear, so master them well to enhance your training!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"That concludes the explanation
regarding the 'principles.'
Do you have any other questions?"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Regarding "Legend's Guidance", yes?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Legend's Guidance" is a special power
that can be bestowed upon you
by a Legend Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"It can be bestowed by the Legend Umamusume who has
imparted the most lessons to you by a certain time."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Because each of them possesses different strengths,
the effects and conditions of their guidance
vary greatly from one to another.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
This is a chance for the Umamusume to grow by leaps and bounds!
Let's keep these principles in mind and proceed with our training even more efficiently!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That concludes the explanation
for "Legend's Guidance".
Is there anything else you would like to know?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Are you truly all right?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Understood♪ Just to be sure, I have a brief summary right here.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You can review that explanation at any time
by tapping the 'i' button in the top left.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Well then, best of luck.
I'll be cheering you on quietly.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Understood. In that case, do your best,
okay? I'll be quietly cheering you on.
